blocks.text: About this document

This document contains the scene-by-scene scripts for every Reel and video, and the slide-by-slide or page-by-page copy for every carousel and LinkedIn document. On-screen text is final copy; voiceover is written to be read naturally, about 2.5 words per second. All video carries burned-in captions.

Scene-by-scene script

rows: Hand slides a mouse off the desk
Unplug your mouse. Can you still use your own website?
Dec 3 · International Day of Persons with Disabilities · 3 checks in 60 seconds
It's the International Day of Persons with Disabilities. Three checks, sixty seconds.
Screen recording: pressing Tab through an Apex demo page; focus outline visible vs. missing (split screen)
1 · Press Tab. Can you see where you are?
One: press Tab. If you can't see where you are, keyboard users can't either.
Screen recording: image alt-text field in a CMS
2 · Do key images have alt text?
Two: give your important images alt text that describes what they show.
Split screen: light-grey text on white vs. dark text on white
3 · Is your text easy to read?
Three: if any text is light grey on white, fix the contrast.
A starting point, not a full audit.
These catch common issues. They're not a full audit. We design to WCAG standards. DM us if you'd like help.
Save this and try it this week.

were filed in US federal court in 2025, up 27% from 2024. Source: Seyfarth Shaw, Mar 2026.
Every link and button should show where you are when using Tab.
Describe what the image shows and why it matters. Skip 'image1.jpg'.
Light grey on white looks elegant and reads badly. Choose dark text on light backgrounds.
Every video with speech needs captions, burned in or closed.
Visible labels and plain-language error messages, not placeholder-only fields.
This is not legal advice. For compliance questions, speak to a qualified professional.
